name: 61602 · Peoria, IL
findings: ZIP 61602 (Peoria) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61602 (Peoria) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
